text: ちからが　はいりすぎてた　かな？

structure.jp: ちからが　はいりすぎてた
structure.en: I was putting in too much force

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる stuck onto a verb says it is done too much. ちからが はいりすぎてた = 'too much force was going in', so 'I was trying too hard'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end turns the sentence into a question you ask yourself. はいりすぎてた かな = 'was I trying too hard, I wonder'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てた is the short spoken form of ていた, which says something was going on for a while. はいりすぎてた = 'was going in too much'.
